findings.why: Meccanica C S.p.A. (Chieri) has an OPEN 8D on EN AW-6061-T6, which is the billet grade of BR-180 under its approval AP-0207. The proposed move of 40% of BR-180 volume to Meccanica C falls under this open issue. The approval is current, but the open issue is still a blocker.
